answer: Admission hinges on hardware, not wallets: the tundra is the registry, a cipher is one clone, and pigment is the non-rentable attested key each identity must buy. One key anchors one identity; reuse is rejected. Available hosts ask 10, 20, 30 and so on USDC, so ten clones cost 550 USDC and the hundredth host alone adds 1,000 USDC. Parallel buyers cannot share keys or skip that supply order. Counterfeit silicon or registry capture breaks it.
